subject: general
question: Length of train A and B is 200 metre and 400 metre. They are running in opposite directions. They cross each other in 30 seconds. Speed of train A is 15 { m/s} . What is the speed (in m/s) of train B?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ **Relative Speed** in **opposite direction** = (Sum of Lengths) ÷ Time Relative Speed = (200 + 400) ÷ 30 = 600 ÷ 30 = 20 m/s Speed of **Train B** = Relative Speed − Speed of **Train A** Speed of **Train B** = 20 − 15 = 5 m/s **∴ The correct answer is 5 m/s.**
